principles: Host-neutral workflow commands remain outside adapter namespaces.
Learning observation is advisory and non-authoritative; it must not become proof or gate evidence.
Only measure real correctness/workflow questions: candidate existence, consumption, and recommendation backlog.
Prefer conservative classification over optimistic inference from DONE success.
drivers: M7/M8 automation should not be built unless real candidate/recommendation backlog exists.
Users need one command to inspect production learning state without hand-reading JSONL ledgers.
Candidate playbooks must not leak into active runtime guidance or automatic activation.

options.name: extend-playbook-promotion-status
cons: Status command is broad and not shaped around observation-window proof
Would blur operational posture with M7/M8 readiness analysis

options.name: add-read-only-observe-command
pros: Creates a purpose-built host-neutral proof surface for candidate generation, consumption, and recommendation handling
Can support --since relative windows and machine-readable JSON without changing activation behavior
cons: Adds one new CLI command that must be registered in policy/catalog/fact-level metadata

options.name: add-automation-now
pros: Would close more of the activation loop
cons: Adds trial traffic or auto-activation risk outside the current evidence boundary

rationale: A dedicated read-only observe command answers the real M7/M8 readiness question without mutating learning state, changing runtime memory, or adding premature automatic activation.

preMortem.scenario: Observation accidentally treats DONE success as helped
preMortem.trigger: Implementation counts candidate existence plus story completion as consumption
preMortem.mitigation: Only count helped/consumed when outcome rows have candidate status and exposureMode != none plus structured verdictSource

preMortem.scenario: Recommendation backlog appears handled too optimistically
preMortem.trigger: Any decision row is treated as complete
preMortem.mitigation: Classify handled from current playbook status or non-deducible registry, otherwise report unhandled

preMortem.trigger: Reuse of sweep/apply helpers or locks with append side effects
preMortem.mitigation: Use readPlaybooks/read outcome diagnostics/read decision diagnostics/read registry only and smoke assert no learning files are created for empty store
